SBC for two-level flocker models

Jacob Socolar

2026-10-14

Source: vignettes/articles/sbc_twolevel.Rmd
sbc_twolevel.Rmd

Rmd parameters 

##             Parameter value
## 1     n_sims_twolevel  1000
## 2   n_groups_twolevel    40
## 3 max_sites_per_group     3
## 4 max_visits_per_site     4
library(flocker)
library(brms)
library(SBC)
set.seed(1)

Overview

This document is one of a series of simulation-based calibration exercises for models available in R package flocker. Here, our goal is to validate flocker’s data formatting, decoding, and likelihood implementations, and not brms’s construction of the linear predictors.

We simulate a twolevel_single model with a ragged number of sites per group and a ragged number of visits per site. Every simulated dataset contains groups with one, two, and three sites, as well as sites with one, two, three, and four visits. We randomly reorder the sites and the rows of the group covariate table before calling make_flocker_data(), so this exercise also checks the packing of groups whose sites are not contiguous in the user-supplied data.

The group-level, site-level, and visit-level formulas each contain an intercept and one numeric covariate. We use independent standard-normal priors for all six coefficients and draw the data-generating coefficients from those same priors.

Two-level single-season 

f_meta <- ~ 0 + Intercept + group_cov
f_occ <- ~ 0 + Intercept + site_cov
f_det <- ~ 0 + Intercept + visit_cov

twolevel_prior <-
  brms::set_prior("std_normal()") +
  brms::set_prior("std_normal()", dpar = "occ") +
  brms::set_prior("std_normal()", dpar = "Omega")

simulate_twolevel_data <- function(
    n_group,
    max_sites_per_group,
    max_visits_per_site) {
  stopifnot(
    n_group >= max_sites_per_group,
    max_sites_per_group == 3,
    max_visits_per_site == 4
  )

  coefs <- rnorm(6)
  names(coefs) <- c(
    "meta_intercept", "meta_slope",
    "occ_intercept", "occ_slope",
    "det_intercept", "det_slope"
  )

  group_names <- paste0("group", seq_len(n_group))
  group_cov <- rnorm(n_group)
  level2_prob <- boot::inv.logit(
    coefs["meta_intercept"] + coefs["meta_slope"] * group_cov
  )
  level2_state <- rbinom(n_group, 1, level2_prob)

  n_sites <- sample(seq_len(max_sites_per_group), n_group, replace = TRUE)
  n_sites[seq_len(max_sites_per_group)] <- seq_len(max_sites_per_group)
  n_unit <- sum(n_sites)
  group_id <- rep(seq_len(n_group), n_sites)
  level2_group <- factor(group_names[group_id], levels = group_names)

  site_cov <- rnorm(n_unit)
  occ_prob <- boot::inv.logit(
    coefs["occ_intercept"] + coefs["occ_slope"] * site_cov
  )
  unit_state <- rbinom(n_unit, 1, level2_state[group_id] * occ_prob)

  n_visits <- sample(seq_len(max_visits_per_site), n_unit, replace = TRUE)
  n_visits[seq_len(max_visits_per_site)] <- seq_len(max_visits_per_site)
  observed_visit <- outer(
    n_visits,
    seq_len(max_visits_per_site),
    FUN = function(n, visit) visit <= n
  )

  visit_cov <- matrix(rnorm(n_unit * max_visits_per_site), nrow = n_unit)
  det_prob <- boot::inv.logit(
    coefs["det_intercept"] + coefs["det_slope"] * visit_cov
  )
  unit_state_by_visit <- matrix(
    unit_state,
    nrow = n_unit,
    ncol = max_visits_per_site
  )
  obs <- matrix(NA_integer_, nrow = n_unit, ncol = max_visits_per_site)
  obs[observed_visit] <- rbinom(
    sum(observed_visit),
    1,
    (unit_state_by_visit * det_prob)[observed_visit]
  )
  visit_cov[!observed_visit] <- NA_real_

  unit_covs <- data.frame(level2_group, site_cov)
  level2_covs <- data.frame(
    level2_group = factor(group_names, levels = group_names),
    group_cov
  )

  # Exercise packing when neither input table is already in group order.
  unit_order <- sample.int(n_unit)
  obs <- obs[unit_order, , drop = FALSE]
  visit_cov <- visit_cov[unit_order, , drop = FALSE]
  unit_covs <- unit_covs[unit_order, , drop = FALSE]
  level2_covs <- level2_covs[sample.int(n_group), , drop = FALSE]
  row.names(unit_covs) <- NULL
  row.names(level2_covs) <- NULL

  flocker_data <- make_flocker_data(
    obs = obs,
    unit_covs = unit_covs,
    event_covs = list(visit_cov = visit_cov),
    type = "twolevel_single",
    level2_group = "level2_group",
    level2_covs = level2_covs,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  list(coefs = coefs, flocker_data = flocker_data)
}

# Make the Stan code.
model_name <- paste0(tempdir(), "/sbc_twolevel_model.stan")
example_data <- simulate_twolevel_data(
  params$n_groups_twolevel,
  params$max_sites_per_group,
  params$max_visits_per_site
)

scode <- flocker_stancode(
  f_meta = f_meta,
  f_occ = f_occ,
  f_det = f_det,
  flocker_data = example_data$flocker_data,
  prior = twolevel_prior,
  backend = "cmdstanr"
)
writeLines(scode, model_name)

twolevel_generator <- function(N) {
  simulated <- simulate_twolevel_data(
    N,
    params$max_sites_per_group,
    params$max_visits_per_site
  )

  list(
    variables = list(
      `b_Omega[1]` = unname(simulated$coefs["meta_intercept"]),
      `b_Omega[2]` = unname(simulated$coefs["meta_slope"]),
      `b_occ[1]` = unname(simulated$coefs["occ_intercept"]),
      `b_occ[2]` = unname(simulated$coefs["occ_slope"]),
      `b[1]` = unname(simulated$coefs["det_intercept"]),
      `b[2]` = unname(simulated$coefs["det_slope"])
    ),
    generated = flocker_standata(
      f_meta = f_meta,
      f_occ = f_occ,
      f_det = f_det,
      flocker_data = simulated$flocker_data
    )
  )
}

twolevel_gen <- SBC_generator_function(
  twolevel_generator,
  N = params$n_groups_twolevel
)
twolevel_dataset <- suppressMessages(
  generate_datasets(twolevel_gen, params$n_sims_twolevel)
)

twolevel_backend <-
  SBC_backend_cmdstan_sample(
    cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(model_name)
  )

twolevel_results <- compute_SBC(twolevel_dataset, twolevel_backend)

plot_ecdf(twolevel_results)
